Petitioner/Accused:

sentences.text:
Respondents/State:
 State Of Kerala, Represented Public Procecutor, High Court Of
 Kerala, Ernakulam, Pin - 682031.

This Bail application coming on for orders upon perusing the petition and upon hearing the arguments of SRI.P.T.SHEEJISH, Advocate for the petitioner and PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the respondent, the court passed the following:
 VIJU ABRAHAM, J  ....................................
 B.A.No. 715 of 2023  .................................................................
 Dated this the 20th day of January, 2023  ORDER

The petitioner is the sole accused in Crime No.912/2022 of Kondotty Police Station in Malappuram District, alleging commission of offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 420, 406 & 506 of Indian Penal Code.
2. The prosecution allegation is that, the accused person has wrongfully restrained the defacto complainant, voluntarily caused hurt and has also committed cheating.
3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the aforesaid crime.
It is also submitted that the petitioner is working as a sales man and delivery boy in a company owned and run by the defacto complainant.
The petitioner was not paid his sales commission and bonus amounting to Rs.80,000 Saudi Riyals.
Now the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present crime.
4. The learned Public Prosecutor to get instructions in the matter.
The petitioner shall not be arrested in the meanwhile.
